title: Staff write a Space's check-in link onto an NFC placard from the CyberUnicorn console, and a phone tap checks a member in

source.ref: §7 Check-in placards. Owner 2026-10-20 in the project thread: staff write any Space's check-in onto a sticker with the Unicorn, a member taps it with their phone and it stamps their Regulars card; the console mirrors the Unicorn's screen over USB.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. PREMISE RE-TESTED: the CyberUnicorn console (LIVE-1168, LIVE-1180, LIVE-1181) could write only member cards; a Space's door check-in existed only as a printed QR code, and nothing recorded an NFC sticker for a Space. Built: public.space_tags (supabase/migrations/20270346019000_space_tags.sql, RLS on, revoked from public, anon and authenticated, service role only, internal in scripts/table-grants.txt and in scripts/rls-deny-all.txt), lib/devices/space-tags.ts (listSpaceTags, recordSpaceTag, removeSpaceTag, latestCheckinSince, all behind consoleStaffGate), lib/devices/tag-actions.ts (startSpaceTag returns signedNodeUrl for the Space's door node, made by ensureCheckinNodeForStaff in lib/spaces/checkin.ts if the Space has none; finishSpaceTag records the chip read back; readSpaceTags; dropSpaceTag; checkPlacardTap polls captures on that node). Console: pick any Space, write the link with frequency.write_tag onto an NTAG213/215/216, list and remove placards, and a tap step that shows '<name> checked in' when a phone lands on the check-in. Removing a placard from the list only stamps removed_at; the signed link on the sticker keeps working (signed node codes carry no expiry). The console also gains a live USB mirror of the Unicorn's screen (Bruce display start stream, lib/device/screen-mirror.ts) with Next, Prev, Select and Back over screen.nav, and plays the boot animation while the board boots. EVIDENCE 2026-10-20: the migration is applied to production. Sprite-drawn screens (the boot scene, Light Show, Spectrum) mirror as blank or a placeholder, and Bruce can stop the stream without saying so; the console has a Refresh.

verify.note: Fails when space_tags loses its migration, RLS or revoke, leaves the internal grant list or the deny-all list, when a placard action stops gating on platform staff or stops writing the signed door link, when the console stops starting, finishing or checking a placard tap or stops sending screen.nav, or when the screen mirror module goes away.
